scope: Personal UPSC CSE Prelims 2027 GS-I portal

ai.context_policy: Use portal-local evidence first; never invent stored values; distinguish web evidence from portal evidence.
ai.memory: Browser-persistent AI memory and training notes under dedicated V8.6.1 localStorage namespaces; V8.7 remains backward-compatible.
ai.web_search: Attach built-in web_search only when starting a new Mistral conversation; follow-up appends omit tools.
ai.admin: Allow-list only; no code execution, secret extraction, data deletion, or security bypass.

security.note: Local portal password gate uses a salted PBKDF2 hash on the device. The password itself is never stored or sent to the server. This is a client-side personal-use lock, not a server-side account/authentication system.

performance.boot: Shell-first boot; heavy search index remains lazy; background hydration avoids blocking the initial gate.

preservation.policy: Additive integration; original V8.4 data and views preserved
preservation.engine: Existing 50-slot engine preserved; first 46 slots enriched from imported schedule; remaining 4 stay unbound.

verification.browser_live_note: Container Chromium was not usable for a reliable visual browser run in this environment; Vercel live browser verification remains deployment-side.
